name: Who Killed Hannibal
meaning: Eric Andre shoots a man, then turns to the camera and asks who did it. For blatantly causing a problem and then acting baffled about the cause.
when_to_use: text1 = the one doing the damage (Eric Andre, top). text2 = the victim (on the couch, top). text3 = his innocent question, classically "Why would [someone] do this?" (bottom). The hypocrisy is the punchline.
